Definition: neuter of G3052; an utterance (of God):--oracle.
BiblicalUsage: lógion means oracle, and the contexts could hardly be more different. In Romans 3:2, "because that unto them were committed the oracles of God."; and in Acts 7:38, "and [with] our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:". In Hebrews 5:12, "ye have need that one teach you again which [be] the first principles of the oracles of God"; and in 1 Peter 4:11, "[let him speak] as the oracles of God".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the oracles of God are a trust, not a trophy — committed to Israel, received in the wilderness, and spoken now by any man who speaks. I hold that the first principles of those oracles are milk for babes and the measure of teachers. My position is that if I speak, I will speak as the oracles of God, and let God be the judge of my words.
